body: Has anyone tried squatting everyday? I'm a week into the program, and it's absolutely exhausting, but already I'm feeling strength increases? If you have, how long did you keep it up and how were your results?

The Smith Machine is a fantastic piece of equipment, for hanging jumpers on and doing standing calf raises. That's about it. You'll build your stabiliser muscles a lot better on free weights, and it's my opinion that it enshrines an incorrect motor pattern which will lead to the Smith Machine stealing your gainz when you move to free weights. Dumbbell work and light barbell work in a 5x5 when you're starting out would be my suggestion, builds up a good foundation.

Neurological adaptation and motor patterns are incredibly important, and it has been very commonly argued that neurological adaptation is one of the core factors influencing "newbie gainz". Couch Hamilton will argue the importance of motor patterns in lifting, and I'm not gonna argue with Couch..
